title: Design for FAQs: 5 Essential Tips for a Great User Experience
why: FAQ design best practices aligned with Nielsen Norman Group heuristics on content organization, scannability, and volume handling.
found_via: web search FAQ design Nielsen Norman
finding: Fewer than 20 questions: list prioritized by importance; 20+ questions: group by category, max 7 per group; 50+ questions: use accordions

title: StatusBadge – Beautiful, Accessible Status Indicators
why: Status badge component design with built-in states (success, error, warning, info, pending) and accessibility considerations.
finding: Compact visual indicators for status; support multiple tones and sizes; content limited to single word; meaning not conveyed by color alone

title: Negative Space In Graphic Design
why: Academic treatment of negative space and its role in design composition.
